visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long, straight black hair is seen from the back, wearing a white textured cardigan. White question boxes with Traditional Chinese text float over her hair. (2) She turns to the side, holding a black cylindrical spray bottle and pointing it towards her scalp; she wears a silver ring and has a small tattoo on her hand. (3) She looks down at a smartphone, then the camera cuts to a white tiled floor with scattered strands of dark hair. (4) A close-up shot focuses on her hair parting, showing the scalp surface. (5) She holds a large orange-tinted translucent bottle of shampoo labeled 'Hair Recipe' towards the camera, smiling with light makeup and pink lipstick. (6) A sequence follows showing hands vigorously scrubbing hair covered in thick white foam against a white-tiled background. (7) She is seen wearing a pink bathrobe over her white cardigan, touching her hair roots while looking into the camera. (8) Split-screen and sequential shots compare hair on a drain and hair partings with 'Before' and 'After' labels. (9) She sits at a desk with a book, touching her hair and smiling. (10) She brushes her long hair with a large wooden paddle brush. (11) Final shot: she holds the shampoo bottle, smiles broadly, and gives a thumbs-up to the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice speaks in Mandarin with a clear, friendly, and narrative tone. The background music is a gentle, mid-tempo acoustic track featuring piano and guitar in a major key. (2) A transient 'shhh' sound occurs, mimicking the sound of a pressurized spray bottle being activated. (3) The narration continues with slight vocal inflections indicating concern when discussing hair loss, while the BGM maintains a consistent, warm texture. (4) A percussive, rhythmic scrubbing sound with liquid textures is heard, representing hair washing. (5) The speaker's tone shifts to a higher arousal and more positive valence as she describes the benefits of the product. (6) A soft 'thud' and the sound of dry hair being handled or brushed are heard towards the end. (7) The music and voice fade out cleanly at the conclusion.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Problem Identification -> Product Solution -> Evidence/Results -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the 'Hair Recipe' Ginger Tea shampoo by addressing common hair and scalp problems such as thinning, sensitivity, and hair loss caused by styling products, then demonstrating the efficacy of the product through personal testimony and visual comparisons.
